ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Mars

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Spend five minutes in silence before going to sleep.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.
